title: Foundations for Program Evaluation
description: Provides an overview of the concepts, models and issues in evaluation. Introduces the practice of program evaluation, including: determining evaluation questions and approaches to use; developing an evaluation plan; planning data collection; establishing reporting processes and addressing ethical issues. Introduces contemporary issues in the field such as environmental, social, political and cultural dynamics of an evaluation context.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 537, ADMN 437, CD 512.
recommendations: It is recommended that students have completed a previous course in research design or research methods.
